title: Designing Cooperative Molecular Glues for FKBP12-MAPRE1 with Enhanced-Sampling Molecular Dynamics Simulations.
authors: Chen, Shu-Yu; Solazzo, Riccardo; Fouche, Marianne; Roth, Hans-Jorg; Dittrich, Birger; Riniker, Sereina
journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
one_liner_zh: 该文利用增强采样MD模拟设计FKBP12-MAPRE1系统的协同分子胶，通过构象系综采样和模型预测实现蛋白-蛋白相互作用诱导剂的理性优化，属于蛋白质结构计算建模与设计研究。
abstract: Molecular glues (MGs) offer a unique modality for inducing protein-protein interactions (PPIs), yet their rational design is often hindered by the limitations of static structural data. Here, we present a computational pipeline for the design of cooperative MGs for the FKBP12-MAPRE1 system using replica exchange with solute scaling (REST2) for enhanced sampling in molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. By sampling the conformational ensembles of binary and ternary complexes, we identified a "stabilized configurational space" that facilitates ternary-complex formation through a combination of conformational selection and induced-fit mechanisms. Based on the simulations, we developed a model that correlates PPI induction information from the simulations with the experimental cooperativity. This model was subsequently used to select and rank a small library of compounds prospectively, of which five were selected for synthesis and testing. Three of the five new compounds exhibited apparent cooperativity equal to or greater than that of the best previously known variants. This study demonstrates that targeting shared configurations within dynamic ensembles is a viable strategy for the rational optimization of cooperative molecular glues.
abstract_zh: 分子胶（MGs）为诱导蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）提供了一种独特模式，然而其理性设计常受限于静态结构数据的局限性。在此，我们提出了一种计算流程，用于设计针对FKBP12-MAPRE1系统的协同分子胶，该流程采用溶质缩放副本交换（REST2）方法以增强分子动力学（MD）模拟中的采样。通过采样二元和三元复合物的构象系综，我们识别出一个“稳定化构象空间”，该空间通过构象选择与诱导契合机制的组合促进三元复合物的形成。基于模拟结果，我们开发了一个模型，将模拟中的PPI诱导信息与实验协同性相关联。该模型随后被用于前瞻性地选择和排序一个小型化合物库，其中五种化合物被选用于合成和测试。五种新化合物中有三种表现出与先前已知最佳变体相当或更高的表观协同性。本研究证明，靶向动态系综中的共享构象是理性优化协同分子胶的一种可行策略。
